text:
Ava: Heads up 3 enforcement rollout for short-lived interactive sessions across dev infra. Policy 'short-session-enforce-2026' will auto-expire interactive shells idle >2h or overall >6h. Go-live: 2026-05-05 09:00 UTC. Read and act — small changes required.

security-bot: Full rollout doc: https://internal.redwood/sec/short-session-enforce (includes exception flow, audit log fields, and rollback plan). Policy ref: SHORT-SESSION-ENF-2026.

Leo: Does this affect background CI or scheduled kubernetes Jobs?

Ava: No, CI and non-interactive workloads are unaffected. This targets interactive terminals: dev-shell, bastion sessions, and internal workspace shells.

Priya: Action checklist for teams?

Ava: 1) Stop using interactive shells to run long-running daemons; use k8s Job or systemd unit. 2) Replace long-lived personal tokens in shells with ephemeral creds (our OIDC flow or gcloud short-lived). 3) Submit exceptions before 2026-05-03 if you have hardware rigs or other valid needs.

DevX: We're shipping an update to dev-shell-wrapper that shows a 10m reauth warning and attempts automatic credential refresh where allowed. Staging will get the flag on Tue Apr 28.

Leo: If someone loses work when their session expires, what's the recommended pattern?

Ava: Persist state outside the interactive shell: checkpoint to S3, run experiments in k8s Jobs, or use ephemeral multiplexers only during active debugging (<2h). Add repo docs for reproducible runs.

Priya: How do we request an exception?

security-bot: Exception requests: https://internal.redwood/requests/sec-exception?policy=SHORT-SESSION-ENF-2026. Exceptions require owner, justification, expiration date (max 30 days), and weekly review.

DevX: Ops note: to list current interactive sessions run: ```
./dev-shellctl sessions --json | jq '.sessions[] | {user,started,idle,tty}'
# expire sessions older than 6h
./dev-shellctl expire --older-than 6h
```

OpsOncall: We'll enable a canary (5% sessions) on 2026-05-03, monitor error rate and developer help requests. Rollback window: 3h on day-of.

Leo: Where can I watch how many sessions will be impacted?

security-bot: Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/mon/dashboards/short-session-impact. Current estimate: ~320 interactive shells >6h. We'll post hourly during canary.

Priya: Any pinned procedures for oncall if rollout causes widespread breakage?

Ava: Ping #eng-oncall and tag @Ava and @DevX; include at least one session-id and logs from `dev-shellctl`. We'll triage and either grant short exceptions or rollback the flag.

DevX: Reminder: This is targeted at reducing credential exposure risk from unattended shells. Please migrate any persistent services out of personal shells before the go-live.

Ava: Thanks everyone. If you need help migrating, file a ticket and we'll pair. (reaction :rocket:)
